youtube_title: The house on I Street: LaPorte's 'granddaddy' of ghost stories
body: The late LaPorte County historian Fern Eddy Schultz called an old house on I Street the granddaddy of local ghost stories. Around 1960, a family living there said a woman in old-fashioned clothes appeared in an upper window. Later, the house came down, and a medical clinic now stands on the site, where staff told of instruments laid out for patients disappearing and doors opening and closing on their own. Schultz collected stories like these for years and told them at the county museum. It's a working clinic: please don't bother the staff. 👻 Comment your town, and it could be next! #LaPorte #LaPorteCounty #Indiana #Haunted #History #LaPorteAfterDark
